decision: The CW system (intake, 2 x 50 % CW pumps, pipes, outfall) is designed for 38,000 m3/h total; the condenser tube velocity limit 2.2 m/s caps the flow at 38,000 m3/h. The HMB guarantee case keeps 36,050 m3/h (7 K rise).
rationale: Margin for fouling, plugging and cold-ambient duty; IEC confirmation TQ-IEC-009.
title: Circulating water system design flow 38,000 m3/h
